loginHeadline: Highly available PostgreSQL, built and run from one place.
loginHighlightInventory: Deploy HA clusters onto your own VMs from a role-based inventory
loginHighlightPatroni: Switchover, failover, restarts and config with Patroni
loginHighlightObservability: Grafana, Prometheus and Alertmanager for every cluster
signInFailed: Couldn't sign in. Check that the console is running and try again.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Please sign in again.
obsIntro: Dashboards, metrics and alerts for each cluster. The links point at the VM with the Monitoring role in the cluster's inventory; you can change them per cluster.
obsReachHint: These tools run on your cluster VMs, so your browser has to reach them. If you open JumboSQL through an SSH tunnel, start a SOCKS proxy instead (ssh -D 1080 root@<kvm-host>) and point your browser at localhost:1080.
obsNoClusters: No clusters in this project yet.
obsNoMonitoring: This cluster has no VM with the Monitoring role. Add one in the inventory, or set the URLs with 'Edit URLs'.
obsGrafanaHint: Dashboards for PostgreSQL, Patroni, etcd and the VMs.
obsEmbedHint: Shows Grafana inside JumboSQL. Grafana must allow embedding (allow_embedding = true in grafana.ini).
obsEditHelp: Leave a field empty to use the address from the inventory.
